name: Data Protection Grievance Officer
text: In accordance with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 ('DPDP Act') and the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, the Data Fiduciary has designated a Grievance Officer to address complaints and queries regarding the processing of personal data. The name and contact details of the Grievance Officer are as follows: Name: {{grievance_officer}}; Designation: Grievance Officer; Email: {{grievance_officer_email}}; Address: {{company_address}}. Any data principal may submit a grievance or complaint to the Grievance Officer within a reasonable time. The Grievance Officer shall acknowledge receipt of the grievance within 48 (forty-eight) hours and resolve the same within 30 (thirty) days of receipt, in accordance with Rule 4 of the IT Rules, 2021 and applicable provisions of the DPDP Act, 2023.
invalid_if: Contact details for the Grievance Officer are missing or incomplete
title: Grievance Officer
dispute_hotspots: Stale contact information — grievance officer no longer reachable

verification_flags.raised_by: Client review, September 2026 — 'Check whether the IT Intermediary Rules actually apply to LegalAId'.
verification_flags.question: Whether the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021 apply to the party adopting this policy. An intermediary under section 2(1)(w) of the IT Act, 2000 receives, stores or transmits a record on behalf of another person; a service that generates content for its own users may fall outside that.
verification_flags.why_not_resolved_here: The answer depends on what the adopting party actually does, which is a fact about the business rather than a property of the clause. Citing the Rules where they do not apply asserts obligations the party does not have.
